IPT.evidence_source: [/page/19/Text/6] The S-C intervention was based on Rehm's most recent intervention program for depressed adults (Rehm et al., 1984), which combines both cognitive and behavioral training. [/page/20/Text/3] The BPS intervention was based in part on Lewinsohn's (1974) work and thus programmed for an increase in activity and social skills training.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/19/Text/4] Subjects ranged in the severity of depressive symptomatology, which was, in part, a function of using subjects' scores on the CDI as the primary selection criteria. Selection for future research should be based on an interview measure of depression, such as the Kiddie-SADS (Puig-Antich & Chambers, 1978), in which a DSM-III diagnosis can be made.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/19/Text/2] Results of correlations involving the CDI, CDS, CDRS-R, and the depression subscale of the CBCL were nonsignificant and of a negligable magnitude: r = .21, r = .07, and r = .09, respectively. [/page/19/Text/2] The investigators, as well as other authors (e.g., Kazdin, 1981), believe that children can accurately and validly report their symptoms of depression and that they should be considered to be the primary source of information. [/page/19/Text/3] but only youngsters in the S-C condition reported a significant improvement in self-concept. [/page/20/Text/3] The BPS intervention was based in part on Lewinsohn's (1974) work and thus programmed for an increase in activity and social skills training. [/page/18/Text/6] This suggests that the children started participating in more activities in general and social activities in particular during treatment. [/page/20/Text/3] It also became apparent to the therapists that the children could have benefited from some intervention at the cognitive level since some of the children exhibited a negative style of processing information. [/page/20/Text/4] Since many children identified family problems as a source of their difficulties and some of them felt that their parents would not help, it would be useful to incorporate a family component into the treatment program.
